verdicts.root_cause: sidecar/services/locale.py:176-178 instrument_region returns IN only for an nse_direct/nse/bse provider or a .NS/.BO suffix, and defaults every other symbol to REGION_US. Indian indices served by yfinance (^NSEI, ^BSESN, ^NSEBANK) are therefore dated against the closed US calendar and read 'eod' during NSE hours. The same default also forces .AX and other foreign listings onto the US calendar.
verdicts.acceptance_test: sidecar/tests/test_quotes.py: freeze the clock at _NSE_HOURS and monkeypatch get_quote to return provider='yfinance' and timestamp=_NSE_HOURS for ^NSEI and ^BSESN. Under X-Vysted-Region IN and under US, assert client.get('/quotes/%5ENSEI').json()['freshness']=='live' (same for ^BSESN). Also assert locale.instrument_region('^NSEI','yfinance')=='IN'.
verdicts.note: Live run at HEAD, 10:01 IST (NSE open, US closed), sidecar on :52375. The entry's own repro holds fixed: AAPL under IN reads 'eod', not 'live'. The certified pytest and the Portfolio cue vitest both pass. The verifier's probe reproduces: ^NSEI with a timestamp 1 second old reads 'eod', and ^BSESN and ^NSEBANK do the same, under both IN and US regions. This is the same freshness-wrong-calendar class through the narrow default-to-US branch. Separately, nse_direct stamps RELIANCE 2026-09-24T00:00:00Z at 10:01 IST on 09-25 with market_state REGULAR, so a live NSE quote reads 'eod'. That is a data-lane timestamp issue to triage on its own.

verdicts.root_cause: src/components/SettingsPanel.tsx:1938-1941: the Settings > Modules switch calls useModulesStore.setModuleEnabled for bridged plugin:<id> modules and bypasses the lifecycle owner (useMarketplaceStore.enable/disable, which drives runtime plus plugins.db). The plugin's panels and commands are hidden while the Marketplace and Plugin Manager report it active. Because workspace.ts:309-313 now drops plugin:* flags from the blob, the Settings 'off' is silently undone on relaunch when the runtime re-attaches from plugins.db.
verdicts.acceptance_test: src/components/SettingsPanel.test.tsx: bridge moduleForPlugin(CATALOG_BY_ID['vysted-example']) (appendModules plus setModuleEnabled true), render SettingsPanel, and click 'Vysted Example Plugin enabled' in the Modules region. Assert either that useMarketplaceStore disable('vysted-example') was invoked (runtime.disablePlugin writes plugins.db), or that plugin:* rows are not free toggles there. In both cases, enabled['plugin:vysted-example'] must never be false while the runtime reports the plugin active.
verdicts.note: The entry's own repro holds fixed at HEAD: the workspace.test PLATFORM-013 test and the runtime defaultEnabled test pass, and a blob with plugin:x=false no longer hides a re-enabled plugin. The verifier's claim was driven with a scratch vitest that reuses the SettingsPanel mocks. The Settings toggle wrote only the module flag, made no sidecar call, was dropped from the serialized blob, and came back as true after a simulated relaunch. Env note: the main worktree node_modules lacks @tiptap/extension-list (declared in package.json:31), so the stock SettingsPanel.test.tsx fails to import at HEAD in this checkout. The scratch run stubbed that package.
